fields.description: Human name for this source, quoted back in the agent's report, e.g. "Teams meeting transcript".
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Where the transcript comes from. Sources are tried top to bottom and the first one that returns text wins, so put the most trustworthy source first.
fields.label: Source Type
fields.options:
Field on Interview
Attachment on Interview
Attachment on Job Applicant
Python Method
HTTP Endpoint

fields.description: Transcript layout. Auto sniffs it from the text and the file extension, and is right for almost everything. Pin a format only when a provider's output is being mis-detected.
fields.label: Format
fields.options:
Auto
Plain Text
WebVTT
SRT
JSON

fields.description: Optional JSON map from the speaker labels this source emits to the role they play, e.g. {"Speaker 1": "Interviewer", "Speaker 2": "Candidate"}. Names matched from the Interview's own interviewer and applicant records do not need an entry.
fields.label: Speaker Map (JSON)

fields.depends_on: eval:["Field on Interview", "Attachment on Interview", "Attachment on Job Applicant"].includes(doc.source_type)
fields.label: On the Document

fields.description: Fieldname on Interview holding the transcript. Text fields are read as-is; an Attach field is followed to the file.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.depends_on: eval:["Attachment on Interview", "Attachment on Job Applicant"].includes(doc.source_type)
fields.description: Which attachment to pick, matched against the file name, e.g. *transcript*. Empty means the most recently attached readable file.
fields.label: File Name Pattern

fields.description: Dotted path to a whitelisted function called as fn(interview=<name>). It may return the transcript as a string, or a dict carrying text / segments / file_url. This is the hook for a provider integration (Teams, Zoom, Meet, a vendor API) that needs its own auth.
fields.label: Method Path

fields.description: URL to fetch, as a Jinja template with doc (the Interview) in scope, e.g. https://vendor.example/transcripts/{{ doc.custom_transcript_external_ref }}. Must be a public http(s) address.
fields.label: Endpoint (Jinja)

fields.description: Optional JSON request headers, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}. Rendered as Jinja with doc in scope.
fields.label: Headers (JSON)

fields.description: Optional JSON request body, rendered as Jinja with doc in scope.
fields.label: Payload (JSON)

fields.description: Dotted path into a JSON response to the transcript itself, e.g. data.transcript.segments. Empty means the whole response.
fields.label: JSON Path

fields.description: For whoever configures this next. Not shown to the agent.
fields.label: Notes
